description: Resolve up to 50 typed organization names for canonical eligibility input. Only one exact normalized active-publication match with confidence of at least 0.8 is authoritative (`resolved`); a lower-confidence exact match remains `unresolved`, multiple exact matches are `ambiguous`, and prefix candidates are suggestions only. Never convert an unresolved, ambiguous, or suggested candidate into a person fact. Resolution identifies an organization and never establishes eligibility.

candidate_limit.description: Maximum exact matches or prefix suggestions returned per input.

inputs.description: Typed values to resolve in stable input order.

value.description: Organization name as supplied by the user.

name: resolve_eligibility_entities

outputSchema.description: Stable-order exact normalized canonical organization resolution.

disclosure.description: Required warning that resolution does not prove eligibility.

prefix_candidates_are_suggestions.description: True: prefix results must never be silently promoted to facts.

resolution_method.description: Authority rule: one normalized-exact match with confidence of at least 0.8.

results.description: One resolution result per input in the same order.

candidates.description: Exact ambiguity choices or non-authoritative prefix suggestions.

candidates_truncated.description: Whether more candidates existed for this input.

entity.description: Authoritative entity only when exactly one normalized exact match exists with confidence of at least 0.8.

input.description: Original typed value plus its normalized representation.

input_index.description: Zero-based position of the corresponding input.
